label: Slack at the optimum
subgoals: Evaluate each constraint's left side at the optimum
Subtract it from the right-hand side to get the slack
Mark the zero-slack constraints as binding

label: Complementary slackness
subgoals: Set the dual value of every slack constraint to zero
Solve for the remaining duals from the tight constraints
Confirm that the primal and dual objectives agree

label: Shadow prices and their range
subgoals: Read the shadow price as the dual value of the constraint
Multiply it by the change in the right-hand side
Re-solve when the change is large enough to switch the binding set
